pages.title: The crystal's own
text: The terraced mesas keep a crested grazer and a glassy flier in the open, a grub in the caves beneath, and a stalker that walks the crystal at night.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with its own food, named under **Hunting and herding** below. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though none of them has a familiar gift of its own.

pages.title: Chime Grazer
text: A violet, crested grazer in herds of two to four. **24 health** and **3 armour**.
It drops **1 to 3 Chime Crests**, more with Looting.

pages.title: Glass Flitter
text: A pale, glassy flier in ones to threes. **10 health**, no armour.

pages.title: Geode Grub
text: A heavy grub of the dark caves under the mesas, one to three at a time. **26 health** and **5 armour**, very slow, and gentle.

pages.title: Shard Stalker
text: A stilt-legged hunter that rises among the crystal at night, one to three at a time. It has **21 health** and **1 armour**, is quick, and its sting does **5** and poisons you for 3 seconds.
It drops **1 to 2 Shard Barbs**, a Venom reagent.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. Meat drops roasted if the animal died burning. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
- **Chime Grazer**: 1 to 2 Raw Game, up to 1 March Leather and up to 1 Amethyst Shard. Breed with **wheat**.
- **Glass Flitter**: up to 2 Feathers. Breed with **Echo Blooms or any small flower**.
- **Geode Grub**: up to 2 Amethyst Shards. Breed with **Lantern Caps or any mushroom**.
- **Shard Stalker**: up to 1 Amethyst Shard and up to 1 String.
